gloss: to serve out portions; to divide up; to set aside

definitions.gloss: to serve out portions; to dish out
definitions.explanation: To take food from a shared dish and divide it into individual portions.

definitions.gloss: to sort out; to separate; to set aside
definitions.explanation: To select and separate specific items from a larger group.

notes:
Most commonly encountered at restaurants and dinner parties when serving food from shared plates. In Japanese dining culture, shared dishes (⟦{大皿|おおざら}→大皿：04477_oozara⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧) are common, and {取|と}り{分|わ}ける describes the act of portioning food onto individual plates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{分|わ}ける: to serve out food
- ⟦{小皿|こざら}→小皿：04476_kozara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}り{分|わ}ける: to portion onto small plates
- ⟦{均等|きんとう}→均等：19459_kintou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}り{分|わ}ける: to divide equally
- {取|と}り{分|わ}け⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧: serving chopsticks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: to divide; to separate — a more general word for dividing things
- ⟦{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける→盛り付ける：14764_moritsukeru⟧: to plate; to arrange food — focuses on presentation rather than portioning
- ⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧: to distribute; to hand out — implies giving things out to multiple people
